claim: The 2020 ICIMOD/UNDP inventory mapped 3,624 glacial lakes in Koshi, Gandaki and Karnali basins, 2,070 in Nepal.
quoted_support: study found 3,624 glacial lakes located in the three basins, of which 2,070 lakes are in Nepal

claim: 47 lakes are potentially dangerous (21 in Nepal), ranked on lake/dam, glacier and surroundings criteria only; seismic, climate and human triggers excluded.
quoted_support: Other factors, such as extreme climatic conditions, seismic activity, and human interference on or around the lake and on the dam, are not considered.

claim: Inventory recommends updates at least every five years and public GLOF information in varied languages.
stance_target: atlas should show lake inventory, multilingual
quoted_support: an updated and standardized glacial lake inventory should be conducted periodically, ideally at least every five years

claim: Exposed populations: 96,767 Imja, 141,911 Tsho Rolpa, 165,068 Thulagi (ICIMOD 2011).
quoted_support: about 96,767 for Imja Lake, 141,911 for Tsho Rolpa Lake, and 165,068 for Thulagi Lake (ICIMOD 2011)
